findings.message: Delegate expression "${mailer}" runs inside the Camunda 7 engine; Camunda 8 runs no user code in the engine.
findings.suggestion: Implement a job worker for type "mailer" (written as zeebe:taskDefinition type; the original is kept as the "delegateExpression" task header, which the Camunda 7 adapter pattern can dispatch on).
